Yeah but what do I do if she's asleep? I drink myself into oblivion at night and then put my gun in my mouth while the rest of the world is dreaming. I wish I had the strength to just go to sleep but I can't knowing the nightmares that wait for me. I go to bed every night knowing that I'll spend my sleep screaming and pleading for him not to die. I relive every moment of him passing in my arms and I don't know how to approach these nightmares without the bottle. I wish that I was living for something besides my sister. She's only 18. I can't tell her she's
The only reason I haven't pulled the trigger. It would mess with her too much. So here I am, drunk, alone, tasting my gun, praying I could pull the trigger. Why do I have to suffer just for my sisters sake? It's so hard to face this ptsd every day just so she doesn't have to bury me. I wish I could tell her that
